name: cicd-demo
description: CI/CD Demo - Monorepo with microservices, infrastructure, CI/CD, config, and libs

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:services && npm run install:libs
scripts.install:services: cd services/service-a && npm install && cd ../service-b && npm install
scripts.build:all: npm run build:services && npm run build:libs
scripts.build:services: cd services/service-a && npm run build && cd ../service-b && npm run build
scripts.test:all: npm run test:services && npm run test:libs
scripts.test:services: cd services/service-a && npm test && cd ../service-b && npm test
scripts.lint:all: npm run lint:services && npm run lint:libs
scripts.lint:services: cd services/service-a && npm run lint && cd ../service-b && npm run lint
scripts.start:services: cd services/service-a && npm start & cd ../service-b && npm start
scripts.docker:build: cd services/service-a && docker build -t cicd-demo-service-a:latest . && cd ../service-b && docker build -t cicd-demo-service-b:latest .
scripts.docker:push: docker push cicd-demo-service-a:latest && docker push cicd-demo-service-b:latest
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run build:all

author: anandpatil
